response.justification: Despite extensive full-stack and cross-platform experience, the candidate lacks demonstrable C++ development experience in industrial automation, high-performance systems, or secure embedded environments — key requirements for this role. His C++ exposure is limited to a 6-month academic project and no recent professional use, while his career is dominated by JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and web technologies. He also shows no evidence of IEC 62443, MQTT, REST in industrial contexts, or multi-threaded C++ system design.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and open-source project experience with strong documentation and teaching skills.
Proven ability to work across diverse tech stacks and deliver complex systems (e.g., GISCollective, real-time data platforms).
Strong DevOps and CI/CD practices, with experience in Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
concerns: No recent or professional C++ development experience beyond a brief early-career role.
Lacks exposure to industrial IoT protocols (MQTT, OPC UA, Modbus), IEC 62443, or secure embedded systems.
Primary tech stack is web-focused (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang), with no evidence of multi-threaded or low-latency C++ system design.
